messages:
Noah (Support): Customer ticket: BlueOrbit (acct BO-331) got a $9,500 promo credit applied to BO-332 by mistake. They want a credit on BO-331 for next invoice, not a cash refund. Invoice INV-2026-7712 shows -9500.00 on BO-332.

Vera (Finance Ops): Can you paste the invoice line and any promo_external_id? Need to check whether this was auto-allocated during reconciliation.

Noah (Support): Promo external id: APR_BULK_9500. Snippet below.
```
INV-2026-7712 | BO-332 | Promo Credit | APR_BULK_9500 | -9500.00 | USD
INV-2026-7712 | BO-331 | Usage | API | 9500.00 | USD
```
Link (internal): https://redwood.internal/fin/INV-7712

LedgerBot: recon-2026-04-18 matched APR_BULK_9500 -> org BO-332 due to legacy mapping override. Flagged as likely mapping error.

Dmitri (Billing): Plan: reverse the negative credit line on BO-332, post manual credit to BO-331 for $9,500.00, attach partner memo and queue JV if revenue recognized. Need GL.

Vera (Finance Ops): Tax=0. Use GL 7550-PartnerCredits. Olga, can you approve the manual adjustment?

Olga (CFO): Approved. Manual credits for system misrouting up to $15k are pre-approved. Use GL 7550-PartnerCredits and create reversing journal if invoice was closed last period. :white_check_mark:

Reed (Revenue): If the original invoice was recognized in period 2026-03, we'll need JV-RV-7712 to reverse. Vera, please notify revenue once JV is queued.

Priyanka (AM): Partner requests a short confirmation they can share with procurement saying: "Promo credit moved to BO-331; ref INV-2026-7712; no cash refund." Can we include that on their next statement?

Dmitri (Billing): Yes. I'll add the partner-facing memo to the manual credit (MC-7712) and queue it to appear on next billing cycle (2026-05-01). Also filing ticket BILL-3079 to patch mapping logic.

Vera (Finance Ops): Actions: created manual credit MC-7712 for BO-331, amount $9,500.00, GL 7550-PartnerCredits; JV-RV-7712 queued; notified revenue; filed BILL-3079. Partner memo added.

Noah (Support): Thanks team, relaying confirmation to partner now. Closing support thread when they acknowledge. :thumbsup:

Olga (CFO): Good work. Please add this to the billing runbook and include a troubleshooting checklist for promo->org mapping issues.
